answer: Start with Biometric iris uniqueness scan with liveness challenge. The idea is simple: a scan that matches one iris in a billion and needs a live eye, and that comet alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a scan that matches one iris in a billion and needs a live eye takes calendar time as well as money — and the dune is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The lotus is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
